summary: Tested Phase 2 AI recommendations feature for Lead Analytics module. All 4 backend AI endpoints working correctly. Frontend AI tab visible with 3 AI blocks and generate buttons.
seed_data_creation: None - tested with empty data (no leads synced, expected behavior)
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI recommendations feature fully implemented. Key test IDs: data-testid='tab-ai' (AI tab button), data-testid='ai-tab' (AI tab content container). AI endpoints return 'no data' messages when no leads are synced - this is expected. The 4th endpoint (problem-lead-advice) correctly returns 404 for non-existent leads.
